To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the control of the pre-tilt and the anchoring strength in LCDs, which are the most important alignment parameters, can be achieved by the use of novel materials and by the control of the properties of the LC bulk.
the control of pretilt in the case of two alignment components is possible if the anchoring energy of the vertical component is much larger than that of the planar component.

(i) the quality of the vertical alignment can be improved by using composite materials containing perfluoroalkyl units, (ii) the photoalignment properties can be improved by introducing polarizable groups in the photoalignment molecules, (iii) the anchoring strength is not a property of the alignment layer only, but also depends strongly on the properties of liquid crystal bulk, and (iv) the pretilt can be controlled by changing the relative concentration of the two alignment layers.

the development of new materials and the study of the fundamental aspects of alignment in liquid crystals.
the study of two aspects of the alignment of nematic liquid crystals: the study of novel alignment materials and the study of the factors which control the alignment of nematics.
the development of new alignment and photoalignment materials for use in liquid crystal displays and with the control of the alignment in liquid crystals in general.
